newsitem.title: USA: Colonial Line 4 up, running above pre-outage rate.
newsitem.headline: Colonial Line 4 up, running above pre-outage rate.

text.p: Colonial Pipeline said Line 4 section was back up and running at a higher rate than before it was halted earlier on Friday due to damage caused by tropical storm Fran.

The portion of the Colonial pipeline, which carries refined products from Greensboro, North Carolina north to the Baltimore area, was shut by a power outage and restart was delayed because of repairs needed to water-damaged cables.
A pipeline spokesman said the section restarted shortly before 1700 EDT/2100 GMT. "We are running slightly above (the pre-outage rate) to make up for the down-time," he added.
